percent at constant currencies to € 9.4 billion.

### More time for patient care.

Global staff shortages make health care professionals the most valuable resource in hospitals. Their
most limited asset is time. Discover solutions to help free up precious time.

][160]

### New standards in sterile processing and operating room supply

A reliable and efficient supply of the OR is essential for creating daily and long-term success in
hospital processes. Digitally enhanced solutions to achieve clinical excellence.

][161]

### Sustainability from the depths

With the expansion of its disinfectant production facility in Sempach, Switzerland, B. Braun is now
seizing the opportunity to set new standards in energy management.

### A precise view of the future: New digital microscope technology for neurosurgery

New technology allows high-resolution views into the human body, making it a prerequisite for more
precise surgery.

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.
* [ Healthcare Insights ][18]
  
  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance

  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.
* [ Community Engagement ][20]
  
  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# We are Committed to Life

[More][106]
[

### Vision

We strive to transform Fresenius Kabi in the decade to come. We are committed to increase
efficiencies in the therapy and care of patients and improve access to high-quality healthcare
around the globe.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][107]
[

### Excellence

We are specialized in lifesaving medicines and technologies for critically and chronically ill
patients. With our passion and expertise, we touch the lives of almost 450 million people every
year, each one representing the importance of our work.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][108]
[

### Sustainability

We constantly strive to improve our sustainability footprint. For us, meeting the needs of patients
and healthcare professionals goes hand in hand with responsible and ethical management.

[nurse taking hand of woman]
][109]
[

### Think Beyond: Latest Evidence for Effective Therapies in CKD

Join experts at the Global Renal Nutrition Webinar on June 16, 2026. Explore ERA 2026 insights,
protein‑reduced diets, and targeted CKD nutrition.
[Global Kidney Nutrition Webinar Key Visual]
][110]

### Women Who Shaped Us

At Fresenius Kabi, colleagues worldwide share personal stories for International Women’s Day,
honoring the women who shaped their courage and purpose.

countries and additionally two regions.
[Image showing the top employer 2026 seals of the 13 countries and 2 regions.]
][112]

### Four Colleagues, Four Scientific Journeys: Voices of Women in Science

Female scientists from Biopharma, MedTech, Nutrition and Pharma share their stories and advice,
showing how science careers impact patient care and innovation.

Unseen heroes ensure patient safety through precision, care, and smart tech at Fresenius Kabi.

Engineering the

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further

# Improve Lives Through the Power of Nutrition

[ ** ][48]

[sample image]

## Tell Us About Your Successes!

Every day, healthcare professionals around the world improve patient outcomes through the power of
nutrition. Now, your experience can help others do the same.

The ANHI Story Exchange invites you to share a real-world case where nutrition made a meaningful
difference in patient care. Your insights could inspire your peers, inform global best practices,
and be featured across ANHI channels. This is your chance to tell us all about it!

[ LEARN HOW TO SHARE YOUR STORY ][49]
[sample image]

## Key Nutrition Topics

Stay current on the science that shapes clinical nutrition practice with Abbott Nutrition Health
Institute’s Key Nutrition Topics hub. This curated collection brings together free, accredited,
evidence-based education, expert perspectives, and practical resources across priority areas in
nutrition, designed to support informed decision making and better patient outcomes worldwide.
You'll find a variety of education and resources on:
* Breastfeeding
* Cancer
* Diabetes & prediabetes
* Home tube feeding
* Mental health
* Mid-Upper Arm Circumference (MUAC) measurement
* Obesity
* Wound healing

[ BROWSE KEY TOPICS ][50]
[sample image]

## Important Global Nutrition Initiatives

Learn more about how Abbott Nutrition Health Institute is advancing nutrition science and clinical
practice globally through our Important Initiatives hub. This dedicated collection highlights global
efforts that address critical nutrition challenges, support evidence-based care, and elevate
education for healthcare professionals worldwide. You'll find:
* Curated resources for physicians
* Malnutrition resources developed in partnership with Real Madrid
* Our Enteral Nutrition Academy
* Resources for Strength Ambassadors 
* Resources for Glycemic Guardians
* Resources for Growth Ambassadors

[ BROWSE INITIATIVES ][51]

newsletter and other electronic communications.

# innovation powered by empathy

Better patient experience goes beyond the clinic, the hospital, the treatment center. Successfully
managing pain or getting the nutrition they need to heal, grow, and thrive lets people return to
their lives and the things they love. At Avanos, our focus is the future, the next step in the
journey.
This means we are constantly innovating, expanding our global footprint, responding to patient and
provider needs, all with a singular goal:
getting patients back to what matters. 

[ We Are Avanos ][151]
[NOPAIN Act]

In The News

**The NOPAIN Act improves patient access to ON-Q and ambIT infusion pumps for post-surgical pain
management by providing separate reimbursement for these devices when deemed medically necessary. **

This eliminates financial barriers that may exist when the cost of the infusion pump is bundled into
the payment for a covered surgical procedure.

[ Learn More About the NOPAIN Act ][152]

## Pain Management & Recovery Specialties

[Anesthesiologist adjusting anesthesia machine]

### Surgical Pain Anesthesiologists

As an integral part of the healthcare team, the surgeon depends on your expertise to help ensure a
seamless procedure and recovery with minimal disruptions due to pain management issues.

[Explore Specialty][153]
[New business meeting on a conference table]

### Interventional Pain Admin / C-Suite

Effective chronic pain management is a critical component of optimizing hospital operations and
driving growth. You want evidence-based solutions that provide patients with lasting relief, improve
efficiency, and support your facility’s reputation and bottom line.

[Explore Specialty][154]
[Female nurse home caregiver checking a knee to senior woman]

### Ortho Surgeons & Sports Medicine

 For patients carrying the burden of chronic pain, finding effective relief can be life-changing.
They look to you for solutions.

[Explore Specialty][155]
[ View More Pain Management & Recovery Specialties We Support ][156]

## Enteral Feeding Specialties

[Senior woman wearing face mask lying on hospital bed]

### Critical Care Physicians & Nurses

We understand that as a healthcare provider, your primary goal is to ensure the swift and safe
stabilization of your patients. Managing short-term enteral feeding can be challenging, and having
reliable solutions is crucial.

[Explore Specialty][157]
[Mother and pediatrician holding hands with toddler while walking in hospital corridor]

### Pediatric Physicians & Nurses

Enteral feeding plays a vital role in the holistic care of complex and compromised pediatric
patients, and you need reliable, durable products that are easy to place and replace, with minimal
complications.

[Explore Specialty][158]
[Female doctor examining newborn baby in incubator]

### Neonatologists / NICU Nurses / Dietitians

Fat content of HBM plays a vital role in basic physiologic functions of the neonate and is crucial
to weight gain and long-term outcomes. NEOMED* syringe features result in significantly increased
fat delivery to the baby.

[Explore Specialty][159]
[ View More enteral feeding Specialties We Support ][160]

## Recognized Brands, Personalized Solutions

Avanos offers a comprehensive portfolio of solutions encompassing Specialty Nutrition Systems and
Pain Management & Recovery. Our broad range of nutrition delivery products for neonates and
pediatric patients through adult and geriatric patients makes Avanos enteral feeding a vital
lifeline. Our growing selection of pain management and recovery options provides non-opioid
solutions for managing chronic and post-surgical pain.

# ABOUT US

Healthcare is the most important aspect of life, and the pandemic has made this true more than ever.
At Bharati Vidyapeeth Health Sciences, our exceptional team of doctors, nurses and caregivers come
together to bring you excellent care with the latest technologies, best medicine, and warmest
service.

BVMF’S Bharati Hospital is situated on the main Pune – Satara Road in the southern part of Pune
city. The teaching hospital occupies 25 acres of land on a sprawling lush green campus.

The hospital not only functions for clinical training of undergraduate and postgraduate students but
also caters to the medical needs of a large segment of population of South Pune as well as the
surrounding rural areas including poor and needy patients.

# ABOUT US

Healthcare is the most important aspect of life, and the pandemic has made this true more than ever.
At Bharati Vidyapeeth Health Sciences, our exceptional team of doctors, nurses and caregivers come
together to bring you excellent care with the latest technologies, best medicine, and warmest
service.

BVMF’S Bharati Hospital is situated on the main Pune – Satara Road in the southern part of Pune
city. The teaching hospital occupies 25 acres of land on a sprawling lush green campus.

The hospital not only functions for clinical training of undergraduate and postgraduate students but
also caters to the medical needs of a large segment of population of South Pune as well as the
surrounding rural areas including poor and needy patients.

CNP integrates the advanced R&D technologies from Europe and America, with the most advanced
industrial design concept in Western Europe, with the production experience of modern industrial
clusters in North America, with the most efficient and energy-saving product structure research in
Hangzhou, China.

With the application of information technology, CNP has built its own smart factory, taking the lead
in the introduction of SAP resource management system, becoming one of the key units of the key
construction project of  "machine substitution" in Hangzhou, with the whole process of production
information monitoring and tracking, applying laser welding technology to the manufacturing process
of robot pump spare parts in depth, using progressive die technology to ensure the quality of the
whole process of the parts, all of which greatly reduce the production and manufacturing cycle,
provide an intelligent production and manufacturing basis for the pump production.

CNP was recognized as state-certified enterprise technology center in 2016. It is the highest
evaluation level for technology center in China. Besides, CNP has been carrying some technical
courses in 11/12/13th National Five-Year Plan.

CNP uses digital integrated intelligent control technology to create domestic advanced M2M mode,
intelligent control technology.

It includes intelligent current stabilization system, intelligent vacuum suppression system,
intelligent auxiliary control monitoring system, intelligent non-negative pressure full frequency
control system and intelligent water hammer two-way elimination system.

CNP integrates the advanced R&D technologies from Europe and America, with the most advanced
industrial design concept in Western Europe, with the production experience of modern industrial
clusters in North America, with the most efficient and energy-saving product structure research in
Hangzhou, China.

With the application of information technology, CNP has built its own smart factory, taking the lead
in the introduction of SAP resource management system, becoming one of the key units of the key
construction project of  "machine substitution" in Hangzhou, with the whole process of production
information monitoring and tracking, applying laser welding technology to the manufacturing process
of robot pump spare parts in depth, using progressive die technology to ensure the quality of the
whole process of the parts, all of which greatly reduce the production and manufacturing cycle,
provide an intelligent production and manufacturing basis for the pump production.

CNP was recognized as state-certified enterprise technology center in 2016. It is the highest
evaluation level for technology center in China. Besides, CNP has been carrying some technical
courses in 11/12/13th National Five-Year Plan.

CNP uses digital integrated intelligent control technology to create domestic advanced M2M mode,
intelligent control technology.

It includes intelligent current stabilization system, intelligent vacuum suppression system,
intelligent auxiliary control monitoring system, intelligent non-negative pressure full frequency
control system and intelligent water hammer two-way elimination system.

be named colon cancer or rectal cancer, depending on where they start. Colon cancer and rectal
cancer are often grouped together because they have many features in common.

# Enhancing patient care with high-quality medical devices

GBUK develops and distributes high-quality medical devices, supporting patients from the moment of
admission through to rehabilitation. With our specialist products and cutting-edge technologies,
healthcare professionals can treat patients safely and efficiently.

[Watch video][181]
×
[Mask]

## Therapy areas

[View all of our therapy areas][182]
×
* [
  
  ### Enteral Feeding Devices
  
  Safely delivering nutrition to patients, both in hospital and from the comfort of their own homes.
  ][183]
* [
  
  ### Patient Handling
  
  Reducing the risk of injury to patients and professionals with reliable, easy-to-use products.
  ][184]
* [
  
  ### Patient Handling – Community
  
  Explore our range of slings and patient handling equipment designed specifically for comfort and
  dignity in care.
  ][185]
* [
  
  ### Surgical & Critical Care
  
  Specialist products that are widely used in operating theatres, high dependency units and
  emergency departments.
  ][186]
* [
  
  ### Vascular
  
  Safe and effective vascular access with IV cannulas, syringes, needle-free solutions and more.
  ][187]
* [
  
  ### Wound Management
  
  Supporting and sustaining optimal wound care with patient comfort and clinical efficiency in mind.
  ][188]
* [
  
  ### Continence Care
  
  We are dedicated to supporting this essential sector with thoughtfully designed, high-quality
  solutions that enhance comfort, dignity and quality of life.
  ][189]
* [
  
  ### Endourology
  
  Our endourology division offers advanced solutions designed to enhance patient outcomes, with
  range of consumables and integrated smart Operating theatre solutions. Our products can be used in
  BPH, URS and PCNL providing support for all endourology needs.
  ][190]

## Innovative healthcare solutions

For more than 16 years, we’ve designed, developed and distributed life-saving medical devices to the
NHS and across the globe. In this time, we’ve built a reputation for innovation and technical
excellence.

GBUK are recognised for our meaningful impact on the environment throughout the healthcare sector,

zero goal.

### Our purpose!

### [What is HCU?][63]

The Homocystinurias are a group of inherited metabolic disorders leading to the build up of
homocysteine and its metabolites in the blood and urine. 

### [Our Mission][64]

HCU Network America strives to inform and provide resources for patients and families, create
connections, influence state and federal policy, and support advancement of diagnosis and treatment
for HCU and related disorders.

### [Meet Our Board][65]

In 2016, Danae' Bartke, Margie McGlynn, and Kristin Rapp came together to found HCU Network
America.

### Our purpose!

### [What is HCU?][63]

The Homocystinurias are a group of inherited metabolic disorders leading to the build up of
homocysteine and its metabolites in the blood and urine. 

### [Our Mission][64]

HCU Network America strives to inform and provide resources for patients and families, create
connections, influence state and federal policy, and support advancement of diagnosis and treatment
for HCU and related disorders.

### [Meet Our Board][65]

In 2016, Danae' Bartke, Margie McGlynn, and Kristin Rapp came together to found HCU Network
America.

IU Health recommends routine screening mammography as part of breast care for individuals over the
age of 40. And now scheduling your mammogram is easier than ever with our online scheduling tool.
Answer a few questions and then book an appointment at a time and location that works for you.

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

translational and clinical research][97].

## Why Choose Cleveland Clinic?

[patient centered care icon]

### Patient-centered care:

We don’t just care for your health conditions. We care about you. That means [our providers][65]
take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

[national recognition icon]

### National recognition:

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

### Collaborative providers:

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

leader in aerospace, defense, industrial automation, and medical technology. Through change and

way our world moves while building a sustainable business for generations to come.

## This year marks Moog’s 75th anniversary, reflecting decades of resilience and ingenuity.

Founded in 1951 by Bill Moog with a bold vision to empower people and solve tough problems through
trust and innovation, our company grew from a small airplane hangar in East Aurora into a global
leader in aerospace, defense, industrial automation, and medical technology. Through change and
challenge, Moog has remained committed to innovation and culture. Today, we continue to shape the
way our world moves while building a sustainable business for generations to come.

# About NeoChild

### [“Protecting the patients who need protection the most.”][19]

At NeoChild we are proud to be “*protecting the patients who need protection the most*.” With senior
management boasting over 40 years of neonatal and IV therapy experience, we have been able to
develop quality products to aid the neonatal population. NeoChild has not only continued to develop
various patented safety products, but we have vertically integrated the majority of our
manufacturing processes to bring manufacturing on-shore to solidify the supply chain due to the
issues presented during and since the pandemic.  Value Ad Capabilities include cost savings
opportunities and on-shore production/sterility for an efficient supply chain partner.

NeoChild offers two safety enteral feeding systems to prevent misconnections, as well as, urinary
catheters, IV extension sets, and custom convenience kits.

# About NeoChild

### [“Protecting the patients who need protection the most.”][19]

At NeoChild we are proud to be “*protecting the patients who need protection the most*.” With senior
management boasting over 40 years of neonatal and IV therapy experience, we have been able to
develop quality products to aid the neonatal population. NeoChild has not only continued to develop
various patented safety products, but we have vertically integrated the majority of our
manufacturing processes to bring manufacturing on-shore to solidify the supply chain due to the
issues presented during and since the pandemic.  Value Ad Capabilities include cost savings
opportunities and on-shore production/sterility for an efficient supply chain partner.

NeoChild offers two safety enteral feeding systems to prevent misconnections, as well as, urinary
catheters, IV extension sets, and custom convenience kits.

## ASPEN Leads the Science and Practice of Clinical Nutrition

ASPEN is a global interprofessional community of dietitians, nurses, nurse practitioners,
pharmacists, physicians, physician assistants, researchers, scientists, and other health
professionals. We provide resources across every facet of nutrition support, including clinical
practice, research, and education.

We envision a world in which every patient receives safe, effective, and high-quality nutrition
care.

[ Learn About Membership ][137]

Do you need to discuss a nutrition-related patient case with fellow clinicians? ASPEN Member Connect
is an online community where you can network, learn from peers, and get your questions answered!
[Visit Member Connect][147]

## ASPEN Leads the Science and Practice of Clinical Nutrition

ASPEN is a global interprofessional community of dietitians, nurses, nurse practitioners,
pharmacists, physicians, physician assistants, researchers, scientists, and other health
professionals. We provide resources across every facet of nutrition support, including clinical
practice, research, and education.

We envision a world in which every patient receives safe, effective, and high-quality nutrition
care.

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is

goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

Authority (PA) is a score developed by Moz that predicts how well a specific page will rank on      
search engine result pages. Page Authority scores range from 1 to 100, with higher scores           
corresponding to a greater ability to rank.

# About Srisan

Our company is lead by one of the leading Neonatologists who has over 20 years of experience. Given
the positive feedback he and the neonatal community had after working with the Neotech products both
in the UK and India, he has been inclined to set up Srisan, with the objective of making them easily
available to clinicians. Srisan has an efficient team who believe in delivering high-quality care.
Over the past three decades, Neotech has emerged as an essential brand in NICUs around the world.
Ground-breaking products from this company benefit both patients and clinicians as they focus on
Making a Difference in the NICU, PICU and Beyond. Neotech understands that the quality of products
used in such a sensitive environment is of the utmost importance to clinicians. It has developed a
series of products designed to be gentle on tender skin and these products strictly comply with FDA
and ISO standards.

Our company is lead by one of the leading Neonatologists who has over 20 years of experience. Given
the positive feedback he and the neonatal community had after working with the Neotech products both

available to clinicians. Srisan has an efficient team who believe in delivering high-quality care.
